description: This file contains the implementation of Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) in PyTorch, which involves wrapping nn.Modules to shard their parameters across distributed training processes, manage state, facilitate checkpointing, and handle asynchronous communication during training. It defines the core class `FullyShardedDataParallel`, related enums, and associated methods to control distributed data parallel training with sharding strategies.

classes.description: Enum representing key types in optimizer state-dicts, either by parameter name or parameter ID.

classes.name: FullyShardedDataParallel
classes.description: Main class implementing module parameter sharding across distributed processes, with numerous methods for managing training states, checkpointing, and module wrapping.

methods.description: Re-keys the optimizer state dict to switch between parameter name and parameter ID keys, facilitating compatibility between models with different parameter keying.
